```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Set CRAN mirror
options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

# Install missing packages if needed
packages <- c("readr", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "MatchIt", "haven", "rstudioapi", "broom", "patchwork", "janitor", "scales")

# Install missing packages and load them
for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  } else {
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}
```

# 1. Load datasets
```{r}
roster <- read_csv("dataset/roster98.csv") |> 
  clean_names()
s91 <- read_csv("dataset/s9_1.csv") |> 
  clean_names()
s92a <- read_csv("dataset/S9_2a.csv") |> 
  clean_names()
s75 <- read.csv("dataset/S7_5.csv") |> 
  clean_names()
s81 <- read_csv("dataset/s8_1.csv") |> 
  clean_names()
s82   <- read_csv("dataset/s8_2.csv") |> 
  clean_names()
```

# 2. Replace Inf with NA in all datasets (convert to double first)
```{r}
fix_inf <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), as.double)) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~na_if(.x, Inf)))
}

s91 <- fix_inf(s91)
s92a <- fix_inf(s92a)
s75 <- fix_inf(s75)
s81 <- fix_inf(s81)
s82 <- fix_inf(s82)
```

# 3. Quick checks
```{r}
# Quick checks
cat("Rows (roster):", nrow(roster), "\n")
cat("Rows (S9_1):", nrow(s91), "\n")
cat("Rows (S9_2a):", nrow(s92a), "\n")

glimpse(s91 |> 
          select(hhcode, s9_1q2, program) |> 
          slice(1:5))
glimpse(s92a |> 
          select(hhcode, s9_2aq8) |> 
          slice(1:5))
glimpse(s81 |> 
          select(hhcode, s8_1q3, s8_1q4) |> 
          slice(1:5))
```

# 4. Create treatment variable
```{r}
# s9_1q2 == 1 → household joined a microcredit program
treat <- s91 |>
  group_by(hhcode) |>
  summarise(treatment = ifelse(any(s9_1q2 == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0))

treat
```

# 5. Total loan amount per household
```{r}
loan <- s92a |>
  group_by(hhcode) |>
  summarise(loan_amount = sum(s9_2aq8, na.rm = TRUE))

loan
```

# 6. Construct income
```{r}
# Food: s8_1q3 (own production) + s8_1q4 (purchased)
food <- s81 |>
  mutate(food_value = coalesce(s8_1q3, 0) + coalesce(s8_1q4, 0)) |>
  group_by(hhcode) |>
  summarise(food_total = sum(food_value, na.rm = TRUE))

food

# Non-food: s8_2q3
nonfood <- s82 |>
  group_by(hhcode) |>
  summarise(nonfood_total = sum(s8_2q3, na.rm = TRUE))

nonfood

# Self-employment: s7_5q6
selfemp <- s75 |>
  group_by(hhcode) |>
  summarise(selfemp_income = sum(s7_5q6, na.rm = TRUE))

selfemp
```

# 7. Combine all income sources
```{r}
income <- roster |>
  select(hhcode, weight) |>
  left_join(food, by = "hhcode") |>
  left_join(nonfood, by = "hhcode") |>
  left_join(selfemp, by = "hhcode") |>
  mutate(
    food_total     = replace_na(food_total, 0),
    nonfood_total  = replace_na(nonfood_total, 0),
    selfemp_income = replace_na(selfemp_income, 0),
    total_income   = food_total + nonfood_total + selfemp_income
  )
```

# 8. Merge treatment & loan info
```{r}
hh <- income |>
  left_join(treat, by = "hhcode") |>
  left_join(loan, by = "hhcode") |>
  mutate(
    treatment   = replace_na(treatment, 0),
    loan_amount = replace_na(loan_amount, 0)
  )
```

# 9. Summary checks
```{r}
summary(hh$total_income)
table(hh$treatment)
```

# 10. Descriptive statistics
```{r}
desc <- hh |>
  group_by(treatment) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_income   = mean(total_income, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_income     = sd(total_income, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_income = median(total_income, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

desc
```

# 11. t-test
```{r}
t_res <- t.test(total_income ~ treatment, data = hh)
t_res
tidy(t_res)
```

# 12. Correlation: loan amount vs income
```{r}
cor_data <- hh |> filter(loan_amount > 0)
cor_val <- cor(cor_data$loan_amount, cor_data$total_income, use = "complete.obs")
cat("Correlation between loan amount and income:", round(cor_val, 3), "\n")
```

# 13. Visualizations
```{r}
# Boxplot: income by treatment
boxplot_income <- ggplot(hh, aes(x = factor(treatment), y = total_income)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3, fill = "skyblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +          # ✅ show normal numbers
  labs(
    x = "Access to Microcredit (1 = Yes)",
    y = "Household Income (Taka)",
    title = "Household Income by Microcredit Access"
  ) +
  coord_flip()

boxplot_income

ggsave("boxplot_income.png", boxplot_income, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

# Scatterplot: loan amount vs income
scatter_income <- ggplot(hh |> filter(loan_amount > 0),
       aes(x = loan_amount, y = total_income)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +           # ✅ show normal numbers
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +           # ✅ show normal numbers
  labs(
    x = "Loan Amount (Taka)",
    y = "Household Income (Taka)",
    title = "Relationship between Loan Amount and Income"
  )

scatter_income

ggsave("scatter_income.png", scatter_income, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)


# Bar chart: average income by program
avg_prog <- s91 |>
  group_by(program) |>
  summarise(
    avg_income = mean(hh$total_income[match(hhcode, hh$hhcode)], na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

bar_income <- ggplot(avg_prog, aes(x = factor(program), y = avg_income)) +
  geom_col(fill = "lightgreen") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +           # ✅ show normal numbers
  labs(
    x = "Program",
    y = "Average Household Income (Taka)",
    title = "Average Income by Microcredit Program"
  )

bar_income

ggsave("bar_income.png", bar_income, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

# 14. Save outputs
```{r}
write_csv(hh, "merged_microcredit_income.csv")
```
